acceptance: RED then GREEN: the Manager-only official recovery entry produces exactly one kg.worktree.child-receipt.v1 for a resolved legacy child with child_receipt missing only when persisted campaign manifest, manifest digest/base, complete partition/ticket set, exact branch/path/tip, typed hand-back seal, and verifiable completed child manifest all match. Tests cover r3 campaign-retire=child-receipt-missing and r4 campaign claim/child mismatch. Every named negative refuses with no mutation: missing manifest, missing receipt source, incomplete child manifest, base drift, tip drift, manifest digest drift, Scope drift, branch drift, path drift, handback-seal-time-mismatch, invalid seal, active child, dirty worktree, unhanded child, and claim/child mismatch. A hand-back seal or tip alone never creates a receipt; campaign-retire remains fail-closed; missing receipt is never reported fixed or pass. Repeating the same valid request is idempotent with no duplicate receipt, while changed evidence refuses with no mutation.

detail: legacy campaign child-receipt/provenance recovery；owner=platform-steward；parent=none；sequence=independent recovery lane, but serialize integration with IMP-20260819-1df6a3 because the two test files are shared；dependency=persisted campaign manifest, manifest digest/base, complete partition/ticket set, exact branch/path/tip, typed hand-back seal, and verifiable completed child manifest. Reuse the existing Manager-only official campaign-retire/recovery entry；no new user-facing or agent-facing CLI surface is planned, so docs/reference/tech_index.md is intentionally outside this Scope. plan: 1. Add RED coverage for a Manager-only, atomic, re-entrant legacy provenance recovery/audit path at the existing official campaign-retire/recovery entry; keep campaign-retire fail-closed. 2. Permit kg.worktree.child-receipt.v1 production only when persisted campaign manifest, manifest digest/base, partition/ticket set, exact branch/path/tip, typed hand-back seal, and a completed child manifest all match exactly. 3. Exercise r3 child-receipt-missing as the recoverable resolved-child case and preserve explicit r4 campaign claim/child mismatch refusal. 4. Name and refuse every missing or drifting source: missing manifest, missing receipt source, incomplete child manifest, base drift, tip drift, digest drift, Scope drift, branch drift, path drift, seal-time drift, invalid seal, active, dirty, or not-handedback state; no mutation on every refusal and never infer a receipt from a seal/tip. 5. Make success atomic and reruns idempotent: identical valid evidence reuses the same receipt without duplication; changed evidence refuses without mutation. 6. Add focused tests for the positive path, each named negative path, atomic no-mutation snapshots, and repeated invocation. 7. Do not add a parser or docs surface; if a new CLI becomes unavoidable, stop and split the docs/reference/tech_index.md contract work before implementation. Shared test files must not be parallel-written with IMP-20260819-1df6a3.
